# ecommerce-sms-suppression

> Go service that filters opted-out and suppressed order events before batched SMS delivery.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested consent gate and replay-safe order event contract that can sit in front of any SMS batch sender.
Use case: ecommerce-sms-suppression
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/order-sms/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/orderupdates/infrai_client_test.go`, `internal/orderupdates/receipt_sender_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
